compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined Exiles are called to praise toward restored Jerusalem beside Return from the nations is promised after return to God; Jerusalem speaks hope to children carried away; Jerusalem is told to watch the gathering; Paradise and the tree of life are prepared. Those passages share its Eden-and-exile evidence group or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
